name: Huascarán National Park
description: Huascarán National Park protects most of the Cordillera Blanca in Peru's Ancash region, the highest tropical mountain range on Earth. Its centrepiece, Mount Huascarán, climbs to 6,768 metres above a landscape of glaciers, turquoise lakes and deep torrent-carved ravines. The park stretches about 150 kilometres and shelters spectacled bears, Andean condors and vicuñas.
